title: Parables of the Kingdom of Heaven
intro: In Matthew 13, Jesus tells seven parables about the kingdom of heaven. They reveal mysteries about how God's kingdom works in the world.

items.title: The Sower
items.text: The seed falls on four types of soil - a path, rocky ground, among thorns, and good soil. It is about how people receive God's word.

items.title: The Weeds
items.text: An enemy sows weeds among the wheat. Both grow together until the harvest (judgment).

items.title: The Mustard Seed
items.text: The smallest seed grows into a large tree. God's kingdom starts small but grows into something enormous.

items.title: The Yeast
items.text: A little yeast works through the whole batch of dough. God's kingdom spreads invisibly but thoroughly.

items.title: The Treasure in the Field
items.text: A man finds a treasure and sells everything to buy that field. God's kingdom is worth everything.

items.title: The Pearl of Great Price
items.text: A merchant finds a valuable pearl and sells everything to buy it.

items.title: The Net
items.text: The net gathers all kinds of fish. At the end of time, the good are separated from the bad.
